fields.title: Conclusion
fields.md:
1. One-sentence conclusion: On 2026-11-16 Buffett gifted 6,150 Class A shares (9,225,000 Class B shares) to four family foundations, bringing his voting power to 29.6% and economic interest to 12.9%, but Berkshire's equity, BPS and share count are unchanged, and on the same day a 13G disclosed for the first time a 6.4% stake in Bending Spoons — the 25/50/25 probabilities and the assumed value band are unchanged (Sources: [13D/A No. 82](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml) · [13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464218/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
2. Briefing in 5 lines
   - Buffett 13D/A No. 82 (2026-11-16): 6,150 Class A shares → converted into 9,225,000 Class B shares, then gifted to four family foundations (roughly $5.47 billion, estimated at the 11/16 closing price)([13D/A](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465884/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
   - After the transaction: 182,140 Class A shares · voting power 29.6% (29.7% in July) · economic interest 12.9% (13.2% in July)(same source · [No. 81](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/315090/000119312526304838/xslSCHEDULE_13D_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
   - Conversion does not change the Class A-equivalent share count or BPS — the gifted amount is 0.66% of Class B shares outstanding (formula).
   - 13G (2026-11-16): Bending Spoons 6.4% · Delta 9.8% · Bank of America 6.6% · VeriSign 6.6% · Kroger 5.9% (9/30)([Bending Spoons 13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464218/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
   - No rules R1–R6 met — scenarios 25/50/25 and assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 maintained · Class B closing price on 11/17: $586.76([stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)).
3. Three data points to check directly before the next issue
   - Bending Spoons initial stake and acquisition cost — is the 6.4% (9/30) the value after settlement of the 'additional stake' (T5, [13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464218/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml) · 4Q26 10-K).
   - Whether Delta stake rises from 9.8% past 10% — 13G amendment · Form 4 (T3, [Delta 13G](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464189/xslSCHEDULE_13G_X02/primary_doc.xml)).
   - Yen bond settlement (2026-11-19) and ¥73.4 billion maturity repayment (2026-11-27) — 4Q26 10-K debt note (T2, [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526465047/d86634d424b5.htm)).
